sources.title: Gravity and basin-depth maps of the Basin and Range Province, western United States
sources.authors_year: R. W. Saltus and R. C. Jachens, 1995
sources.use_in_project: Regional depth-scale anchor only; the H61-G inversion matched the reported fraction of Nevada basin area deeper than 1 km.
sources.limitation: The regional map is not pixelwise ground truth for this raster; the official digital map was not downloaded or independently sampled in this review.

sources.topic: 1 m elevation source proposed for H61-L
sources.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey / The National Map 3DEP
sources.source_check: Official catalog describes a public one-meter DEM collection and states 3DEP products are public domain.
sources.viability_status: CONDITIONAL — exact tile availability for the competition footprint, acquisition dates, CRS, and downloadable files were not checked.
sources.use_in_project: Do not call H61-L data-viable until the exact target-footprint tiles are checked directly in the USGS National Map/3DEP inventory and their IDs/hashes are recorded.
